entities.name: Medvedev Interlude & Putin's Return
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Medvedev-Putin 'tandemocracy' (2008–2012), the 2011–12 protest movement ('For Fair Elections'), Putin's return to the presidency (2012), the Sochi Olympics (2014), repressive legislation against NGOs and LGBTQ rights, and growing confrontation with the West.
